notes.title: Phil Alone - Game Dev Book - Italian Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

So, right now we will be adding a version of Phil Alone - Game Dev Book in Italian to start this year!

The official release will be on 01/16/2023, so please wait a little bit!

To download the DLC in Italian, please just follow the same steps of the original DLC!

"After installed, the DLC will be downloaded in your local folder.
Check the game library, right click "Phil Alone", click "Properties" and find the "Local Files".
It's in the file "Italian Version"."

If you found some bugs, let me know please! 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: NOMINATIONS - STEAM AWARDS 2022
notes.notes:
Hi guys, how are you?

The year 2022 is coming to an end and with it another cycle closes.

Phil Alone was released this year for free on Steam and I'm really happy to see the feedback on the game from many places around the world. And it's the chance for people who played it to nominate the game for the "Best Game You Play Badly" category at the Steam Awards.

Nominations are open until November 29th. And don't forget to nominate other games too!

Thank you all and hope to show you all more new games next year!

Gabriel Dias,
Game Designer

notes.title: Phil Alone - Game Dev Book!
notes.notes:
[h1]Phil Alone - Game Dev Book[/h1]

[h3] "A way to say “Thank You” to every player of Phil Alone - Gabriel Dias" [/h3]

A new booklet of Phil Alone that is full of news of the game development, new arts and a lot of other details!

[h3]Synopsis[/h3]

Phil Alone is a puzzle/horror game based on the old games “Escape The Room”. Phil should find out how to escape the death loop that he is in mysteriously, using the tips that he has in his room.

The initial production was done on a game jam and ended up becoming a huge product because of the players feedback that showed a lot of interest.

Translations were done in different languages and a lot of updates were created to improve the game to the maximum, bringing a better experience to the player.

The game’s release on Steam was only possible thanks to a small crowd funding. The game ended up reaching a huge quantity of downloads in 30 days, showing that a lot of players were interested in the proposal, because the feedback of Steam is found in a really positive way.
